FOOTNOTES

1/ This appropriation is a continuing appropriation and is exempt from the provisions of section 35-190, Arizona Revised Statutes, relating to lapsing of appropriations. (General Appropriations Act footnote)

2/ Included in the lump sum appropriation of \$8,144,700 for fiscal year 2026-2027 is \$10,000 for the purchase of mementos and items for visiting officials. (General Appropriations Act footnote)

3/ General Appropriations Act funds are appropriated as an Operating Lump Sum with Special Line Items by Agency.

Operating Budget

The Baseline includes \$8,144,700 from the General Fund in FY 2027 for the operating budget. Adjustments are as follows:

Remove One-Time Funding

The Baseline includes a decrease of \$(750,000) from the General Fund in FY 2027 to remove one-time operating funding.

Foster Youth Education Success Fund Deposit

The Baseline includes \$1,500,000 from the General Fund in FY 2027 for the Foster Youth Education Success Fund Deposit. This amount is unchanged from FY 2026.

The Foster Youth Education Success Program was established to improve the educational outcomes of children in Arizona’s foster care system.

Coronavirus Relief Fund (GVA2975/A.R.S. § 35-142)

Federal Funds

Source of Revenue: Monies received by the state from the federal COVID-19 response legislation. Arizona received \$1.86 billion from the Coronavirus Relief Fund established by the Coronavirus Aid, Relief, and Economic Security (CARES) Act based on the state’s share of the population.

Purpose of Fund: Monies are allocated by the Governor to supplement costs of the state’s COVID-19 response, including necessary expenditures incurred by the state due to the pandemic public health emergency.

Net expenditures for the Livestock Fair are limited to 30% of all receipts deposited to this fund during the preceding fiscal year. All expenditures from this fund must be recommended by the Livestock and Agricultural Committee and approved by the Governor.
